speaker: EN_A

speaker: EN_A
text: Welcome back to our podcast. Today we’re looking at a fresh report on the offshore renminbi.

speaker: EN_B
text: That’s right. The report argues that CNH is set to outperform, driven by strong capital flows and a supportive policy-related backdrop.

speaker: EN_A
text: So what’s the core question this report is trying to answer?

speaker: EN_B
text: It’s really about whether the renminbi can continue to strengthen even when the US dollar is strong. The answer, based on the data, is yes.

speaker: EN_A
text: Let’s dig into the first key insight. What’s driving this outperformance?

speaker: EN_B
text: The first big factor is China’s strong external sector. Despite the US dollar index rising, USD/CNH has actually fallen. That’s unusual.

speaker: EN_A
text: So the renminbi is behaving differently than other currencies?

speaker: EN_B
text: Exactly. The sensitivity of USD/CNH to a rising dollar is only about 28%, but when the dollar falls, that sensitivity jumps to 62%.

speaker: EN_B
text: So there’s an asymmetric response.

speaker: EN_A
text: That suggests the market is already pricing in a stronger renminbi. What’s the second insight?

speaker: EN_B
text: Corporate FX repatriation is a major driver. In April, net FX trade settlement hit over 47 billion dollars. Exporters are bringing money back onshore.

speaker: EN_A
text: Why are they doing that now?

speaker: EN_B
text: Strong export growth and expectations for further renminbi appreciation.

speaker: EN_B
text: The report notes that a de-escalation in the Middle East could be a catalyst for even more repatriation.

speaker: EN_A
text: So the flow dynamics are very supportive. What about the policy-related side?

speaker: EN_B
text: The recent Xi-Trump summit has created a constructive backdrop. Foreign inflows into China-focused equity ETFs jumped after the meeting,

speaker: EN_B
text: totaling over 2 billion dollars month-to-date.

speaker: EN_A
text: That’s a clear signal of improved sentiment. Are there any technical factors at play?

speaker: EN_B
text: Yes. The daily USD/CNY fixing has been drifting lower, even with a stronger dollar. That’s a deliberate signal from the authorities.

speaker: EN_A
text: And what about valuation? Is the renminbi cheap?

speaker: EN_B
text: According to the report, the renminbi is undervalued by an average of 9.5% across four models. That’s a significant discount.

speaker: EN_A
text: So the case for a stronger renminbi seems pretty solid. But what doesn’t the report fully settle?

speaker: EN_B
text: One open question is the impact of any renewed US dollar strength. The report acknowledges that a stronger dollar could temporarily slow the downtrend.

speaker: EN_A
text: So there’s still some uncertainty there. That’s a good reason to read the full report.

speaker: EN_B
text: Absolutely. The report also has detailed charts on FX settlement and exporter behavior that are worth exploring.
